product.description: The ErgoComfort Pro 300 delivers a blend of support and style for long‑hour work sessions. A breathable mesh back distributes pressure evenly while a padded lumbar cushion adapts to the spine’s natural curve. The chair’s aluminum frame provides stability, and the adjustable armrests accommodate a range of desk heights. Height and tilt can be fine‑tuned via a single lever, and a 360° swivel base allows effortless movement. Designed for both office and home environments, the chair offers a sleek, modern look without compromising comfort.
